MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: Anthro, an alien from the planet Traum, is stealing Earth's energy resources to power his planet- until the Super Friends stop him. Disguising himself as an inspector from Scotland Yard, he enlists the help of the Super Friends to help him steal the Earth's energy to take back to Traum.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: The mysterious Professor Baffles is making money and valuable objects disappear- until the Super Friends unravel his puzzle and stop him. The professor has embarked on a crusade to destroy all literature, art and music with a chemical that he has developed. His two accomplices use Professor Baffles' crusade to extort money from the United States government.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: Professor Goodfellow invents the G.E.E.C. (Goodfellow's Effort-Eliminating Computer), which is capable of running everything in the world, freeing people from all physical labor, brainwork and responsibility. When it begins to malfunction, the Super Friends have to convince him that it's not natural for people to be inactive all the time. It takes all the combined efforts of the Super Friends to repair the computer and return the world to its normal state.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: Glaciers are melting, gigantic whirlpools are forming, and there are icebergs in the South Pacific. When the Super Friends chart these drastic changes in the weather, a pattern soon begins to emerge. They discover that scientist Dr. Thinkwik hopes to shift the Gulf Stream from its regular position to warm his Arctic country, Glacia, but the Super Friends stop him and help him find another way.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: A marine scientist fights pollution by creating natural disasters to force three industrialists to stop polluting. The nation's three leading industrialists receive a warning from a computerized albatross: "Listen to the voice of Dr. Pelagian, you have one hour to stop pollution of the seas before the sea strikes back!" The Super Friends must get the stubborn industrialists to meet with Dr. Pelagian before his tactics endanger the country.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: Dr. Shamon is using a giant magnetic "U," a laser gun, to draw a solid gold meteorite to the Earth. However, he's unaware of the fact that his "sky-mining" technique has reelased some exotic gases from the space cloud, which, when united with the oxygen in Earth's atmosphere, form a green mist and a red mist. The green mist causes animals and plants to grow many times their normal size, while the red mists causes animals and plants to shrink.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: An alien from the plant Solar Terrarium moves the Earth out of its orbit and closer to the sun so his people can move from their own freezing planet. However, this causes destructive heat waves. The Super Friends are told by the government's leading scientist that a strange new wave of magnetism is drawing the Earth from its orbit toward the sun. They must discover what's causing the increased magnetic pull and stop it. The alien is stopped by the Super Friends and guest hero The Flash.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: A misguided scientist uses androids to try to sabotage the space program, but the Super Friends stop him. As the Super Friends watch the launch of Apollo 20, neither they nor the government know that the astronauts aboard have been replaced by androids. Apollo 20 crashes to Earth. Dr. Rebos threatens to sabotage the manned launch to Mars unless the government calls a complete halt to its space program.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: A family of aliens from the planet Balunia leave their polluted planet for a home on Earth. After their flying saucer lands, the balloon people are befriended by the Super Friends. However, the news reports of these unusual guests prompt ambitious scholar Noah Tall to devise a plan to capture the balloon people. When they're kidnapped, the Super Friends must rescue them.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: King Plasto steals raw plastic powder to create Frerp, a special plastic which he uses to confound the Super Friends. The king has been intercepting every shipment of the powder on its way to the government space research station because he intends to use the raw powder for his own means. The Super Friends set out to end his reign of terror.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: A pair of scientists, believing that gold is the root of all evil, set out to destroy it with a blue beam until the Super Friends stop them. A blue ray emitting an ultra-beam has been extracting tiny electrical particles called quarks, turning all the gold remaining in the earth into a useless residual metal. The Super Friends tour various mining regions hoping to find an answer to this phenomenon when they see the mysterious blue jet and the ultra-beam.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.episodeName: The Menace of the White Dwarf
MissingItem.description: A strange UFO penetrates Earth's air space. Along its flight path, it has managed to "pull up" and carry along a number of objects. Col. Wilcox explains to the Super Friends that the UFO snatched up a total of 14,000 tons. Superman soon learns that his old arch-enemy Raven is behind these strange occurrences. The evil scientist Raven has escaped from prison to take revenge.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: Important research projects have been closed down, and the Super Friends are called in to find and restore disappearing air conditioning units. The Super Friends' mission leads then into a strange new subterranean world discovered by a pair of spelunkers. They are forced to fight the creatures of that world, animated trees and rocks.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: Using his micro-wave reducer, mad Dr. Hiram Gulliver shrinks all adults- including the Superfriends- to two inches tall to help the population problem (by saving resources)... and also to rule over them (he will remain full-sized to watch over the mini population of the world). The Green Arrow joins the Superfriends to stop him and to return things to normal.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: Eccentric, ingenious scientist Dr. Laban has stolen the largest diamonds in the world to power his "planet splitter," a device capable of splitting a planet in half, intending to tow half of it to Earth as a second moon. While the Super Friends guard the remaining diamonds in the world, Wendy and Marvin follow Dr. Laban to his secret laboratory, where Laban tells him of his plan.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: A strange spacecraft has been forced to land on Earth after a meteor hit the fuel tank of the craft. In an attempt to return from the planet Sagittarius, the craft begins gathering silicon from sea water to fuel the ship. Aliens from the water planet steal the silicon from Earth's oceans, upsetting the ecological balance and creating a red tide and famine among ocean creatures. The Super Friends stop them and help them find a new source of silicon.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.episodeName: The Brain Machine; Joy Ride; Invasion of the Earthors; The Whirlpool
MissingItem.description: Dr. Cranum uses his brain machine to become a futuristic menace. Two boys joyride in an airplane. Rock creatures threaten civilization. A supertanker captain becomes reckless.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.episodeName: The Secret Four; Tiger on the Loose; The Mysterious Time Creatures; The Antidote
MissingItem.description: A group of four hooded criminals attack the oil industry in an effort to slow down the depletion of fuel supplies and to start using alternative energy sources. The Wonder Twins help save a bus of schoolchildren from an escaped tiger and teach a lesson about jumping to conclusions. After Dictor's motion to take over all worlds by turning everyone old is voted down, he stages a coup. The Super Friends come to the aid of the disposed leader who had escaped to Earth with the last remaining source of chronium which is needed to create a second time medallion. Wonder Woman and Apache Chief go to India to retrieve venom antidotes but the source is a giant cobra. Wonder Woman teaches not to put foreign objects in one's mouth. Aquaman teaches how to make a sun rattler. Superman teaches that smoking does not make kids look grown-up.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.episodeName: Invasion of the Hydronoids; Hitchhike; City in a Bottle; Space Emergency
MissingItem.description: An aquatic alien force is threatening Earth, A girl is kidnapped while hitchhiking, an Earth city is shrunken and abducted by aliens, a space shuttle's botched docking with a space station disastrously cripples their power systems.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.episodeName: Doctor Fright; Drag Race; Day of the Plant Creatures; Fire
MissingItem.description: In an effort to make everyone too afraid to commit crimes and start wars, Dr. Fright releases fear gas from a blimp over Metropolis. Batman & Robin rescue a skateboarder. The Wonder Twins rescue drag-racing teens from a hill's edge. A radioactive meteorite at Big Cypress Swamp creates plant creatures which turn people-and some chickens-into zombie plant creatures themselves. Rima, Batman & Robin chase two escaped convicts out on community service duty who had stolen a truck with dynamite in it. The heroes try to reach them before the heat from the forest fire can ignite it while the escapees rescue a trapped family from the fire. Wonder Woman shows a girl how to make a homemade yo-yo. Superman shows how to treat first-degree burns.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.episodeName: The Monster of Dr. Droid; Vandals; Super Friends vs Super Friends; Energy Mass
MissingItem.description: Dr. Droid's creation of a robot with the brainwaves of a mouse runs amuck in Wheatville. The Wonder Twins try to save two vandals who trash a print shop at Midland High School and then get in trouble in a faulty elevator. The Super Friends are forced to fight each other in a coliseum after they search for the captured Aquaman in an underwater kingdom. An experimental energy mass takes over the controls of a runaway train. Wonder Woman teaches the need for an emergency list while Batman & Robin teach about the dangers of electric wires and sockets.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.episodeName: The Enforcer; Shark; Planet of the Neanderthals; Flood of Diamonds
MissingItem.description: In an attempt to control crime in an undersea society, the council replaces Garth 1 with the ruthless Enforcer as leader who then refuses to relinquish control. The Super Friends assist the deposed leader as he flees his home with soldiers in pursuit. The Wonder Twins try to save two teenagers who face a shark after their boat overturns and teach a lesson on boasting. The Super Friends try to turn time back to undo the damage done when a scientist uses a time tunnel and evolution changing device to change history by letting primitives rule over modern humans. Aquaman and Green Lantern fly to South Africa to try to save diamond miners trapped in a cave in. Superman teaches bicycle safety and the importance of a healthy breakfast. Wonder Woman teaches how to stand a glass of water on a playing card in the "Magic" segment.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.episodeName: The Invisible Menace; Initiation; Coming of the Arthropods; River of Doom
MissingItem.description: Nemus steals an untested underwater mining device which could lead to unknown consequences. The Wonder Twins come to the rescue of a new Bear Club member who's initiation includes taking a photo of a bear at Lonesome Pine Cave. The Super Friends try to stop an attack by the Arthropods who had been banished for crimes on their home planet. Wonder Woman and Rima try to save three geologists who are sentenced to death for disturbing the sacred burial grounds of natives. Wonder Woman teaches how to use a crosswalk. Aquaman teaches a coin vanishing magic trick. Superman teaches that saying no to drugs is the right decision.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.episodeName: Attack of the Giant Squid; Game of Chicken; The Water Beast; Volcano
MissingItem.description: In order to solve the world's food shortage, Dr. Pisces engineers a giant squid whose ink enlarges other sea creatures but soon events spiral out of control. A dispute over a parking spot leads to a game of chicken between two teens in motorboats. Manta unleashes a water beast in an attempt to control the world's maritime commerce. Superman and Samurai attempt to save mistrusting aliens whom have crash landed inside a volcano. Batman & Robin teach the dangers of showing off. Superman teaches a scissors sorcery magic trick, Wonder Woman teaches the importance of vision loss.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.episodeName: The Collector; Handicap; The Mind Maidens; Alaska Peril
MissingItem.description: Superman and Wonder Women track down Newton Domehead who plans to transfer the world's greatest monuments and people into photographs for future preservation. The Wonder Twins help a crippled boy when a friend's van falls off a cliff and the crippled boy is the only one who can get help. Medulla and her Mind Maidens activate a will booster machine for mind control over all women who then shoot energy rays to transport the men to Medulla's lair who then stores them onto computer tape. Apache Chief, Batman and Robin try to save scientists on an arctic expedition from a 40 foot abominable snowman. Aquaman teaches that hitchhiking is dangerous. Wonder Woman teaches how to make a spinning pencil top. Batman & Robin teach the dangers of drinking and driving.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.episodeName: The Fifty Foot Woman; Cheating; Exploration: Earth; Attack of the Killer Bees
MissingItem.description: A professor develops a potion which she believes will give her increased physical strength but it transforms her into a 50 foot woman. A cheating cross country runner struggles with the decision of helping the Wonder Twins with the location of lost Boy Scouts and by doing so, revealing that he cheated in the 10 mile race. The Super Friends defend against an alien space probe that collects mechanical and human specimens. Aquaman and Samurai come to the aid of African villagers trapped by a swarm of killer bees. Aquaman teaches how to treat a drowning victim. Batman & Robin teach how to make a two-way phone. Aquaman teaches the importance of cleaning a wound.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.episodeName: Forbidden Power; Pressure Point; The Lionmen; The Day of the Rats
MissingItem.description: Batman, Robin, and Wonder Woman have their hands full when they rescue Professor Zarkov from the mysterious mutants from outer space. Batman, Robin, and Black Vulcan have their hands full while they try to stop a massive rat infestation.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.episodeName: The Man-Beasts of Xra; Prejudice; The Tiny World of Terror; Tibetan Raiders
MissingItem.description: Superman, Batman and Robin have their hands full when they deal with Dr. Xra and her half-human half-animal man beasts. Superman and Flash must rescue passengers on a stranded aircraft from the Tibetan Raiders.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.episodeName: Frozen Peril; Dangerous Prank; The Mummy of Nazca; Cable Car Rescue
MissingItem.description: First, Aquaman and Superman must act quickly when a villain transforms the world's oceans into a "Frozen Peril." Then, the Wonder Twins aid a girl who's the victim of a "Dangerous Prank." Next, the Super Friends race to stop an unscrupulous professor before he gains control over "The Mummy of Nazca." Finally, Wonder Woman and Atom attempt a "Cable Car Rescue."

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.episodeName: The Marsh Monster; The Runaways; Will the World Collide?; Time Rescue
MissingItem.description: A swamp creature steals the plans for a new engine. A pair of runaways get in trouble. A vengeful scientist tries to get a planet to collide with Earth. A reckless scientist traps himself 2000 years in the future.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.episodeName: The Protector; Stowaways; The Ghost; Rampage
MissingItem.description: Aquaman, Batman and Robin team to stop a pirate who fancies himself "The Protector" of the seas. Next, the Wonder Twins rescue two "Stowaways" when the yachtsman piloting the craft is knocked unconscious. Then, the remaining Super Friends must combat "The Ghost" who's turned Wonder Woman and Superman into spirits. Lastly, when a sacred white elephant goes on a "Rampage" in India, Superman and Green Lantern must learn the cause of the beast's destructive behavior.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: Wonder Woman, Batman and Robin meet up with a misguided genius, Dr. Cranum, and his Brain Machine.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: The Wonder Twins and space monkey Gleek have to teach some youngsters a lesson about the dangers of joyriding in an airplane.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: The Super Friends defeat Dictor, who uses an aging/reverse aging technology as a weapon to depose the peaceful elected president of their planet with his totalitarian rule of fear and keep him from conquering the universe.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: An earthquake occurs in India, where the tremors force many cobras out into the open where they bite villagers, exhausting India's antivenom supply. The Red Cross appeals to the Superfriends for help, who deploy Wonder Woman and Apache Chief to India. The pair learn a gigantic cobra called Kataru lives in a jungle temple, whom they must milk for its venom in order to make antivenom, or else hundreds of people will soon die of envenomation.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: Aquaman, Batman and Robin meet the menacing Hydronoids in a struggle to save the world from their evil invasion.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: The Wonder Twins and space monkey Gleek have a serious problem on their hands when they use their Exxor powers to detour the dangers of hitchhiking when a girl doing so is kidnapped.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: The Super Friends find themselves in critical combat against each other when they become captives of Tyrannic, the ruler of the underseas world of Oceana.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: Wonder Woman with special guests Hawkman and Hawkgirl use their special skills in a space emergency.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: Superman and Wonder Woman show no fear when they meet up with the terrifying Doctor Fright.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: The Wonder Twins, Zan and Jayna, and Gleek have to teach a lesson about the dangers of street drag racing.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: The Super Friends must call on their skills to overcome the perils of monstrous plant creatures.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: Superman and Wonder Woman go on an electrifying adventure when they meet the marauding monster of Dr. Droid.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: The Wonder Twins and Gleek have a few special tricks up their sleeve when a couple of thoughtless students turn into school vandals.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: Batman and Robin with special guest Atom are called on to save a speeding passenger train that has been taken over by a critical energy mass.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: Upon encountering a man named Garth-1 on a South Pacific Island, Wonder Woman and Aquaman head to his home Arcava (an underground city within a deserted South Pacific Island) to help free his people from an evil dictator called the Enforcer.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: The Wonder Twins, Zan and Jayna, must save two boys that are trapped underwater by a shark.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: An evil scientist known as Varko devolves Earth back to a prehistoric planet and brings Neanderthals under his command to the present, which will remain so unless the Super Friends can stop him and retrieve the machine responsible for this from the prehistoric times it was placed in. With the help of Skylab, they build a time tunnel and bring his device back, restoring the world.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: Aquaman and Green Lantern head to Africa to save trapped miners in a diamond mine that is slowly flooding.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: Batman, Robin and special guest Rima battle a raging forest fire and find two escaped juvenile convicts.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: The Wonder Twins and Gleek excel with Exxorian powers when they have to bring a dangerous initiation stunt to a safe ending.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: The Super Friends zoom off in an all out struggle against invading insects from a far off planet, for the entire Earth is threatened by the coming of the Arthropods, led by the evil Insecta.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: Flying over jungle rain forests, Wonder Woman and Rima search for some missing scientists who are about to become victims of the River of Doom.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: Superman and Aquaman find themselves entangled in a deep-sea mystery when they meet the tentacled attack of a giant squid.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: The Wonder Twins, and their space monkey Gleek, teach some young people the serious dangers of playing the foolish game of "chicken."

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: It's the Super Friends' problem when trouble surfaces on the high seas. All are in trouble from the menace of the deep, the marauding Manta and his terrifying water beast.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: Superman and special guest hero, Samurai, face the heat of a volcano in making a dangerous rescue of space aliens too paranoid of the natives to request help.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: Superman and Wonder Woman save priceless treasures and monuments from the greedy grasp of the Collector, who has invented a device that turns objects into photographs and plans to do this to various monuments and artworks to protect the items from decay, destruction and vandalism.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: The Wonder Twins and Gleek help teach a lesson in courage when they rescue a boy from the wreckage of an overturned van.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: The Super Friends must use all of their superpowers in order to overcome the mental mischief of Medula and her power-hungry plans to eradicate all men so women led by her can rule the world.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: Batman and Robin and special guest Apache Chief head toward the Northern Lakes to save an expedition from a giant snow creature.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: A woman named Professor Amy Zhan makes a super strength potion which turns her into a 50-foot woman. Batman, Robin and Wonder Woman must look up to the incredible femme fatale and find a way to bring this 50-foot woman back to normal size. Professor Amy Zahn tries to make Batman 50 feet tall, but is stopped when her assistant sprays her with the antidote.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: The Wonder Twins and Gleek teach a lesson in honesty when a double-crossing cross-country runner has a misadventure in cheating.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: The Super Friends must stop a sinister space probe from the planet Zeno that has visited Earth to capture people and objects for scientific study.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: Aquaman and special guest superhero Samurai use super teamwork to save an African village from the attack of the killer bees.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: Batman, Robin and Wonder Woman must save the world from the mysterious mutants of the space sphere and its forbidden power.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: The Wonder Twins and Gleek travel into the hot desert to cool the dangerous canyon-jumping stunts of some reckless motorcyclists.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: A spaceship controlled by mysterious Lionmen probes for minerals and starts an earth shaking process that splits our planet into pieces. Will the Super Friends meet the challenge?

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: An experimental electronic device turns sewer rats mad. Can Batman, Robin and Black Vulcan save Gotham?

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: Superman, Batman and Robin have to save society from the outrageous genetic experiments of a mixed-up scientist and her half-human half-animal beasts.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: The Wonder Twins and Gleek have to teach a serious lesson in brotherhood when the ugliness of prejudice gets some young people into trouble.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: The Super Friends have to do some big thinking when the world is endangered by a shrinking machine in the hands of a greedy inventor.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: The passengers of a disabled aircraft stranded in rural Tibet get instant attention as Superman and superhero Flash rush to save them from Tibetan raiders.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: Superman and Aquaman turn the heat on the sinister Sculpin's plans to freeze the world's oceans so he can sell their thawed water to desert countries.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: The Wonder Twins and Gleek have to save a girl from the perils of a dangerous prank played by some thoughtless companions.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: The Super Friends are called into action when the weird Professor Korloff brings a mysterious mummy to life to steal a cosmic power source for himself.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: Wonder Woman and her mighty mite friend, Atom, swing into action to save a cable car load of passengers caught in a high wind over a treacherous terrain.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: Superman, Batman and Robin move into action when an inventor's valuable plans are put in peril by the terrorizing tactics of a mysterious Marsh Monster.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: The far-from-home Wonder Twins and Gleek try to rescue some misguided teenagers who face trouble when they decide to become runaways.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: The Super Friends exhibit all their bravery against the super sinister scheme of vengeful Professor Fearo and the threat of a world collision.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: A scientist finds trouble when a time machine puts him 2000 years into the future and he is captured by desert slavers. Superman, Hawkman and Hawkgirl come to his rescue.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: Batman, Robin and Aquaman put to sea in an effort to end the pirating and pillaging of Captain Shark and his immobilizing ray.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: The Wonder Twins activate their special powers to save a couple of girls who try an ill-advised adventure as stowaways and almost become flotsam and jetsam.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: The Super Friends tackle the supernatural when the Ghost, a villain from the past, is freed from his imprisonment and wants to take revenge on Superman and Wonder Woman for imprisoning his spirit by threatening the world with his ghostly fate if they don't surrender themselves to him. Now the other Super Friends members must save Superman and Wonder Woman before it's too late.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: In India, Superman and Green Lantern have their hands full when a huge, wild, white elephant tears through jungles and villages on a rampage-looking for its baby.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: The Super Friends match wits and skills in an underground adventure against the mysterious mining monsters known as the Earthors.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: Aquaman and special guest Black Vulcan find themselves facing the force of a shipwrecking whirlpool.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: Superman, Batman and Robin are outnumbered but not outsmarted when they change the plans of the mysterious Secret Four.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: The Wonder Twins and Gleek point out the error of jumping to conclusions as they tackle an escaped tiger (and try to end the confusion on how the tiger got out in the first place).

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: The Super Friends travel to a far-off frozen planet to rescue an entire Earth city stolen by the marauding Mongor.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: Superman and Aquaman discover a deep down mystery of sinister submarines and sea life as they battle the Invisible Menace.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: From the edge of the Milky Way, a winged creature named Rokan speeds toward Earth. Superman confronts the beast and realizes it’s Rokan, a beast from Krypton which was thought to be extinct and since Rokan is from Krypton she has the exact same powers as Superman. Escaping, the creature wreaks Havoc on Earth. The Super Friends attempt stop to stop Rokan by chasing her and her babies away with Kryptonite.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: Lex Luthor forms a criminal gang called "The Legion of Doom" and uses a dream-machine to make the Super Friends commit crimes. When the Super Friends are forced to turn themselves into police headquarters, the guards reveal themselves to be Bizarro and Cheetah who send the Super Friends to the sun while the Legion of Doom uses the Super Friends' own Justice League satellite with Luthor's mutation device to turn women into Cheetah clones and men into Bizarro clones and commit profitable robberies. The Super Friends return to Earth to reverse the damage done and retake The Hall of Justice.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: The Wonder Twins agree to help Exxor defeat Darkon, a conqueror who has taken over Exxor and made its inhabitants his slaves. With the Wonder Twins captured by Darkon, Batman & Robin must free the twin heroes as the other Super Friends tackle Darkon and his troopers.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: Captain Cold enlists the Fearians of Venus to help the Legion of Doom conquer Earth. They demand a climate like their own, so Captain Cold freezes the planet. When the Flash reverses it, rising steam heats the world. Black Manta burns an island, and Aquaman’s tidal wave spreads water and plant growth. Sinestro hurls comets, and Green Lantern shifts Earth’s orbit, raising temperatures further. With conditions set, the Fearians prepare to remake Earth into Venus II.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: While sailing with Captain Pierre Marcel, the Wonder Twins and Gleek get sucked in a whirlpool. After receiving a distress call from the Wonder Twins, the rest of the Super Friends search for the twins only to get pulled in the whirlpool themselves. They emerge in a Wonder Land that is below the Earth’s crust. The Super Friends must now search for the Wonder Twins and rescue them

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: Brainiac uses a cloaking device to make the Earth look like it disappeared and when Hawkman, Wonder Woman and Black Vulcan are in space trying to find it, Toyman sends a phony distress message that leads them to his sinister black hole planet of toy traps while The Riddler uses his super-riddles to lead the other Super Friends on a wild goose-chase that sends them to their doom. However, the efforts of Superman and Green Lantern foil their attempt and save Hawkman, Black Vulcan and Wonder Woman.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: Three space pirate ships led by Captain Sinbad arrive on Earth and plunder treasures in South America. After a Justice League alert, Superman and Wonder Woman confront them, but Sinbad escapes by hurling buildings aside. During a second clash, Wonder Woman is stunned and captured. At the Hall of Justice, Zan and Jana attempt a rescue but are enslaved alongside a mind controlled Wonder Woman. Disguised as Clark Kent, Superman infiltrates the pirate ship to save them.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: Gorilla Grodd invents a time conveyor to allow anyone to travel through time. Black Manta and Giganta trap Aquaman and Apache Chief in 70,000,000 B.C and rob South Africa's diamond mines, Sinestro and Captain Cold trap Green Lantern and Samurai in 500 A.D and rob King Arthur while Grodd and Solomon Grundy trap Batman and Robin in Ancient Rome and rob Caesar, the emperor. The Legion of Doom learn a hard lesson in underestimating the Super Friends when they are foiled once more.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: A fleet from deep space heads to Earth, hypnotizing children and drawing them to Monument Valley, Arizona. After the Wonder Twins fall under control, the Super Friends respond to a Justice League alert. Batman and Robin guard the children while Superman and Wonder Woman stop a destructive UFO, but are carried into the Anti Matter Universe. The Twins escape, and the team races to Planet Nofan to free the children from an evil genius and bring them home.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: Batman, Robin, Wonder Woman, and Green Lantern guard liquid light at the Astro Chemical Research Plant. Cheetah steals the Lasso of Truth, Brainiac takes Green Lantern’s ring, and Scarecrow grabs the utility belts. The villains stage a kangaroo trial at the Hall of Doom, using the stolen gear as false evidence. Brainiac forces the heroes to battle android doubles, and they must outwit their own weapons to escape before it is too late.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: After a century of sleep, Dracula awakens in the Transylvanian Alps and spreads a glowing powder that turns people into vampires. Batman and Robin are captured at his castle, and Wonder Woman and Aquaman battle swarms of victims. In Vienna, Superman confronts Dracula and is transformed. As the plague spreads, the remaining heroes regroup in Switzerland and seek a rare South American bat in the Andes whose cave gases may cure the curse and stop Dracula.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: Solomon Grundy convinces the Legion of Doom to find a "Monolith of Evil" which gave him his powers. But when four of the Legion's members can't retrieve it, The Riddler tricks the Super Friends into fetching it for them. However, Riddler is in for a surprise when the Super Friends learn the truth of the Monolith's powers and use it to put The Riddler and the rest of the Legion of Doom in their place - as the Monolith itself is not inherently evil, but acts upon the thoughts (evil or good) of whoever controls it.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: An experimental satellite from Kennedy Space Center crashes, releasing deadly radiation. Soon Death Valley is overrun by giant desert beasts. While some heroes investigate the wreckage and battle mutated lizards and earthworms, Wonder Woman traces the source to the fallen satellite. Radiation transforms her, and later the Wonder Twins, into giant creatures. As earthworms threaten California’s coast, the Super Friends must stop the monsters and restore their teammates to normal.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: Bizarro builds a giant ray that enlarges him, Sinestro, Toyman, and Captain Cold to 100 feet, allowing each to seize a continent. After being exiled to Saturn, the Super Friends escape and learn Bizarro overlooked a key detail. The Justice League computer reveals elements left behind that let Superman, Green Lantern, the Flash, and Batman use the same ray. Now giants themselves, the heroes battle their towering foes to save the world.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: Three Kryptonian villains escape the Phantom Zone and expose Superman to Red Kryptonite, causing him to age rapidly. The other Super Friends are captured, and the Justice League computer determines that Blue Kryptonite may reverse the effect. Though deadly to Bizarro, it could save Superman. He pilots the Supermobile to the remains of Krypton to retrieve it, then uses a stolen ray device to send the villains back to the Phantom Zone.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: Lex Luthor uncovers the origins of Superman, Wonder Woman, and Green Lantern and sends the Legion of Doom back in time to erase them. Cheetah replaces Wonder Woman, Luthor steals Green Lantern’s identity, and baby Kal El’s rocket is diverted from Earth. After several teammates are captured, Batman discovers evidence of the altered timeline. Using the Justice League computer, the heroes travel back, undo Luthor’s tampering, and restore their friends.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: In this story the Super Friends have to stop an energy draining monster which exists on computer tape and can appear anywhere at anytime. Wonder Woman and Superman, during one scene, go undercover as a science expert and Clark Kent, in an attempt to learn how the energy creature can be destroyed. One of the scientists working in the lab turns out to be the culprit responsible for unleashing the energy creature. The story borrows heavily from the national headlines of the time during the concerns of a looming energy crisis.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: Gorilla Grodd, in an attempt to take over Gorilla City (a society of super-intelligent apes) with mind-altering vapors is banished as he was before for attempting to overthrow King Solovar. He uses Brainiac's brain-wave amplifier to control anyone in a 100-mile radius and takes over Gorilla City. Solovar, king of Gorilla City, escapes and asks the Super Friends for their aid in stopping Grodd.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: The Super Friends face Torhana, a conqueror freezing everything in his path to punish the surface world. Traveling by ship, he and his crew freeze oceans, continents, and people. Aquaman uses his telepathy to summon swordfish, freeing himself from the ice and returning to Atlantis. Although Torhana seems in control, the heroes regroup and devise a clever plan to melt the planet’s ice. This episode uniquely features Aquaman at his traditional comic book base, the undersea city of Atlantis.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: The Legion of Doom makes a deal with a swamp sorceress and her demon: an equal exchange of good and evil power. They capture the Super Friends as the source of good and put them to sleep in coffins. Greedy for more power, the Legion imprisons the demon, who escapes and summons zombies to attack. Forced to free the heroes, the sorceress advises defeating the zombies, but then reveals she and the demon are the same being, balancing the power herself.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: While in space, Batman and Superman are possessed by brain creatures, who soon control Wonder Woman, Robin, and Aquaman. Under their influence, Superman hurls asteroids at Earth, causing fissures, fires, and floods. Wonder Woman overcomes the mind control, and with a magnetic cloud, the creatures are expelled from all the heroes. She then devises a plan to send an electrical current through Earth, forcing the brain creatures to flee and freeing Superman, Batman, and Aquaman.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: Under a ruse that The Legion of Doom has changed from evil to good, they travel far into the year 3984 to finally conquer the earth. With the Riddler leaving cryptic clues easily broken by Batman, the Super Friends learn in a further century about their takeover and go to 3984 to foil them.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: A crooked space circus proprietor, Zarnum, uses a device to turn protected animals that have been illegally captured into beasts to boost attendance at his space circus. Sensing that the Super Friends are onto his scheme he uses the device to change Wonder Woman, Aquaman, and the Wonder Twins into space creatures. It's up to the rest of the Super Friends to track down the elusive space circus, rescue the captive Super Friends, and bring an end to the poaching that's been taking place.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: Wonder Woman, Aquaman, Black Manta, Cheetah, Scarecrow, Riddler, Batman, Apache Chief, Bizarro and Superman are sent to another universe to engage in a series of contests where the losers will be eliminated while the other Super Friends and Legion of Doom search for their missing colleagues.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: Batman and Robin travel to the planet Texarkana after a distress alert reports the villain Capricorn Kid terrorizing locals. After defeating and imprisoning him, the Kid vows revenge and returns to Earth with his gang, breaking into the Hall of Justice. They trap each Super Friend in dangerous situations, forcing Batman and Robin to rescue them against the clock. The story culminates in an old-fashioned shootout between Batman and the Capricorn Kid.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: Toyman develops a device that can project anyone into the pages of a storybook. He forces Hawkman to chase him into Jack and the Beanstalk, Cheetah forces Wonder Woman to chase her into Alice in Wonderland and Brainiac forces Superman to chase him into Gulliver's Travels and the three villains trap the three Super Friends in the three treacherous fairy tales.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: The Super Friends engage in a space battle when Wonder Woman receives a telepathic message from Aphrodite to help save a planet. Hera, envious of Aphrodite’s praise for mortals, convinces Zeus to test the heroes against mythological demons. Batman and Robin face a Sphinx, Aquaman guards the golden fleece, Superman fights a minotaur, and Wonder Woman battles Medusa. The Wonder Twins turn to stone after seeing Medusa, but Gleek helps free them. By the end, the Super Friends prove worthy of Aphrodite’s praise.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: The Legion of Doom deserts Sinestro, Black Manta and Cheetah after a failed mission and the three villains decide to kill the Legion of Doom for betrayal. Until the Super Friends find out this is just a ploy to get them distracted.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: Aquaman is exposed to a radioactive substance that turns him into a prehistoric sea creature from which he evolved. In order to cure him, Superman and Wonder Woman, inside the Super Mobile, are shrunk down to microscopic size and sent within the creature's veins to attempt to give it another dose of radiation in the hopes that it will reverse the effects of the radiation and return Aquaman to normal. In the meantime the rest of the Super Friends have to do whatever they can to limit the creature's destructive nature all over the city.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: The Legion of Doom unearths a crystal called "Noxium", created by one time member Dr. Natas. The Crystal can kill all of the Super Friends using emulations of their weakness such as Kryptonite, Yellow Power or lethal energy only to find out too late they were in hiding and had really killed off their clones.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.episodeName: The Rise and Fall of the Superfriends
MissingItem.description: The Super Friends are visited by Mr. Mxyzptlk who comes complete with a script for a movie that he wants the Super Friends to star in. The imp uses his 5th dimensional mind control to cause the Super Friends to act out the script...but Superman is not affected by the mind control but he nonetheless goes along with everything in an elaborate plot to trick Mxyzptlk into saying his last name backwards. In one scene a zombie Lois Lane shows up in a wedding dress wearing a kryptonite wedding ring.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: Earth lies in ruins with no life as three aliens investigate the Hall of Justice and Justice League records. A computer malfunction leads them to the Hall of Doom, where they discover Lex Luthor and the Legion of Doom accidentally caused Earth’s destruction while trying to destroy the Super Friends with a solar flare. The aliens reverse the damage and prevent future destruction by placing the Moon in the flare’s path, leaving both Luthor and the heroes baffled.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: Kareem Azaar is a ruthless thief on the Planet Zaghdad who has stolen the Magic Lamp of Olam, which contains the power of an evil genie. Kareem uses the Genie's power to take over the planet and banish the Sultan into the world of the Genie's lamp. When the Super Friends arrive to do battle, Superman and the Wonder Twins wind up in the lamp leaving the other heroes to take on Kareem's forces.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: Lex Luthor uses a reverse camera projector to disguise himself and his assistant Orville Gump as Super Friends in a plot to destroy them. He teams with fire demons from the sun, who help capture the heroes and place them in deadly traps. The demons turn the sun red, stripping Superman of his powers. When they betray Luthor, he frees the heroes. Superman drives them back with the Super Mobile, restoring the sun and his powers. Luthor and Gump return to prison.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: While protecting a prehistoric planet from a meteor, Superman ends up hit by the meteor's nuclear core, crash lands on the medieval planet of Camelon, and loses his memory. A bunch of rebels led by Logan take him in as their black knight in a plan to overthrow King Arthur 7. It's up to the Super Friends to help Superman remember and defeat the rebels.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: What starts off as a camping trip for the Wonder Twins turns into a nightmarish adventure in Middle Earth when the Super Friends must battle a black magic sorcerer named Mal Havok who has taken over the troll kingdom. Mal Havoc uses his magic to turn the Super Friends into trolls. With their powers reduced, Batman and Wonder Woman accompany the troll king on a mission to free Middle Earth of the evil sorcerer.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: In a parallel universe, the Super Friends are super villains. When Mount Vesuvius erupts in both worlds, Superman and his evil counterpart are blown into opposite worlds. While Superman has to fight his evil comrades and find a way back to his own world, his evil counterpart battles the real heroes and begins his plan to conquer the Earth.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: The evil Captain Nimoy plots to use nuclear warhead missiles to sink continents below the sea where he plans to rule. Nimoy is aided by an android duplicate of Batman to help him out, but with Superman and Wonder Woman away on a space mission, the Super Friends are aided by Superman's tiny Kandorian friends from the bottle city of Kandor.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: When Dr. Frankenstein steals the powers of Superman, Batman, and Wonder Woman and transfers them into his latest creation, it's up to Robin to stop the Super-Monster.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: A tornado transports the Hall of Justice to Oz where Mister Mxyzptlk, who has once again escaped from the 5th Dimension, informs the Super Friends that they must find The Wizard to get home. Along the way they encounter the Wicked Witch of the Worst Kind in a gingerbread house who turns Superman into the Tin Man, Wonder Woman into the Cowardly Lion and Aquaman into the Scarecrow.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: Apache Chief, Batman, and Robin face great danger when attacked by Bigfoot creatures.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.episodeName: Big Foot; The Ice Demon; The Make-Up Monster
MissingItem.description: Apache Chief meets a race of aliens who inspired the legend of "Bigfoot". Superman rescues the Wonder Twins from "The Ice Demon". A disgruntled makeup artist transforms himself into "The Makeup Monster" and Batman and Flash stop him.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.episodeName: Journey into Blackness; Cycle Gang; Dive to Disaster
MissingItem.description: Superman, Batman, and Samurai get pulled into a black hole. The Earth is next./The Wonder Twins come to the aid of a car run off the road by a motorcycle gang./An American submarine is in danger. Black Vulcan and Aquaman answer the call.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.episodeName: Yuna the Terrible; Rock & Roll Space Bandits; Elevator to Nowhere
MissingItem.description: While exploring Stonehenge, a group of archaeologists accidentally release "Yuna The Terrible" from her stone tomb. Next, "Rock 'N' Roll Space Bandits" render the Super Friends immobile with their strange, hypnotic music. Then, when Wonder Woman and Atom answer a distress call from a diabolical doctor's laboratory, they plunge into an "Elevator To Nowhere."

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: While monitoring the galaxy from his impenetrable Fortress of Solitude, Superman notices a Black Hole that is going to suck up the Earth. Superman attempts to stop it but gets himself pulled into the Black Hole. Using the Bat-Rocket, Batman and Samurai set out to accomplish what Superman failed to do. However, the two heroes end up getting pulled into an Asteroid Planet in the center of the Black Hole. Upon finding Superman imprisoned, the heroes are attacked by a Star Energy Creature. The Super Friends must break free and stop the Star Creature from absorbing the Earth.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.episodeName: One Small Step for Mars; Haunted House; The Incredible Crude Oil Monster
MissingItem.description: In "One Small Step From Mars," the Super Friends outwit three criminals who've escaped from a prison on the red planet. Then, the Wonder Twins search for two boys trapped in a "Haunted House." Lastly, Aquaman, Hawkman and Hawkgirl battle "The Incredible Crude Oil Monster."

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.episodeName: Voodoo Vampire; Invasion of the Gleeks; Mxyzptlk Strikes Again
MissingItem.description: Batman and Robin fight voodoo vampires in darkest Africa. Black Vulcan assists./Gleek wakes up the Wonder Twins. They are being invaded by Gleek-like space monkeys./Mxyzptlk is back with a magical typewriter.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.episodeName: The Man in the Moon; Circus of Horrors; Around the World in 80 Riddles
MissingItem.description: The moon is like an egg. It cracks open and a moon-size creature emerges. Superman goes to battle it./In Metropolis, Wonder Twins and Gleek are attending the circus when the animals take over./The Riddler shows up in the Batcave.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.episodeName: Termites from Venus; Eruption; Return of Atlantis
MissingItem.description: First, the Super Friends must find a way to halt an unstoppable invasion of destructive "Termites From Venus." Then, Gleek and the Wonder Twins work quickly to save a pair of hang gliders, and an entire town, from a volcanic "Eruption." Finally, in "Return of the Atlantis," even the Super Friends need additional help when an underwater city rises to the surface and the inhabitants attack the nation's capitol.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: A group of archaeologists accidentally releases Yuna the Terrible and her barbarian warriors. Batman and Robin responds to a distress call but get captured by Yuna's warriors. Wonder Woman and Apache Chief respond to the Batman's distress call. During an encounter with Yuna, Apache Chief gets put into a trance and joins Yuna and her warriors. Wonder Woman tries to save them and must prove her strength against Yuna.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.episodeName: The Killer Machines; Garden of Doom; Revenge of Bizarro
MissingItem.description: When an evil computer takes control of Gotham City's electronic equipment, the Super Friends must find a way to stop "The Killer Machines." Next, a professor creates a "Garden of Doom" when he accidentally transforms ordinary tomatoes into huge, man-eating plants. Lastly, the Super Friends fight against the "Revenge of Bizarro" when Superman's old nemesis changes Batman and Robin into Bizarro versions of themselves.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: Green Lantern and Superman must stop the reign of terror caused by Martians who traveled to Earth in a returning space probe.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: Vampiress, the Voodoo Vampire from Africa, goes after the Super Friends and seeks to make them her vampire slaves. It's now up to Wonder Woman and Black Vulcan to go her underground tomb and stop her.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: The Super Friends respond when the moon cracks open, revealing a gigantic destructive bird.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: First, the Super Friends must find a way to halt an unstoppable invasion of destructive "Termites From Venus."

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: When an evil computer takes control of Gotham City's electronic equipment, the Super Friends must find a way to stop "The Killer Machines."

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: When chasing a burglar in Gotham City, Batman and Robin are captured by Pack and Stardust, Bounty Hunters from Orion. Batman attempts to call for help using the Justice League beeper, but he did not realize the Bounty Hunters know help is coming and are ready to ambush them. Wonder Woman and Green Lantern come to save Batman and Robin but instead gets captured and imprisoned as well. The Bounty Hunters tries to take their captives to The Orion Territorial Prison but on the way the Super Friends make a break and go after the Bounty Hunters.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.episodeName: Outlaws of Orion; Three Wishes; Scorpio
MissingItem.description: First, the "Outlaws of Orion" imprison the Super Friends on a bogus charge. Then, the Wonder Twins are in danger when an evil genie offers them "Three Wishes." Lastly, the Super Friends battle a horde of giant insect led by "Scorpio."

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.episodeName: Mxyzptlk's Flick; Sink Hole; Alien Mummy
MissingItem.description: The mischievous imp Mxyzpltk returns to star the Super Friends in "Mxyzpltk's Flick." Next, villainous Diamond Jack threatens a small mining town with a gigantic electronic cobra in "Sink Hole." Finally, El Dorado summons the Super Friends to help him battle an "Alien Mummy."

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.episodeName: The Evil from Krypton; The Creature from the Dump; The Aircraft Terror
MissingItem.description: Superman is rendered helpless by "The Evil From Krypton." Next, "The Creature From The Dump" threatens Gotham City. Later, an eerie ray transforms airplanes into gigantic screeching birds in "The Aircraft Terror."

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.episodeName: The Lava Men; Bazarowurld; The Warlord's Amulet
MissingItem.description: Aquaman teams with the Super Friends to defeat "The Lava Men." Then, Bizarro lures Superman to "Bizarroworld" in an attempt to drive him insane. Finally, Samurai and the Super Friends intervene when a 13th-century warlord escapes his own time to wreak havoc on present-day Japan in "The Warlord's Amulet."

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: The mischievous imp Mxyzpltk returns to star the Super Friends in "Mxyzpltk's Flick."

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.episodeName: The Iron Cyclops; Palette's Perils; Colossus
MissingItem.description: First, the Super Friends fight "The Iron Cyclops" that threatens Metropolis. Next, a villainous artist paints creatures that come to life and do his evil bidding in "The Palette's Perils." Lastly, when the gigantic "Colossus" plays with the planets of the galaxy as if they were toys, Apache Chief devises a plan to stop him.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.episodeName: Stowaways from Space; The Scaraghosta Sea; The Witch's Arcade
MissingItem.description: Keelhaul Kelly and his ghost pirate crew (Single appearance) Other Characters: Dr. Gibbs Paul Locations: Atlantic Ocean Cape of Good Hope The Scaraghosta Sea United States of America Metropolis Hall of Justice

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: Zy-Kree, an escapee from the Phantom Zone (who is very similar to General Zod in both appearance and back story) seeks revenge on Superman by turning the Earth's sun red and thus depowering the man of steel. It is up to Green Lantern and Aquaman to help their friend defeat the evil Kryptonian who has the same powers as Superman.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: After saving a Killer Whale, Aquaman notices the water is on fire and radios Wonder Woman for help who then tells Superman. Meanwhile Aquaman, with the help of his Whale friend helps move a ship from the path of the flaming water. Superman arrives stops the flames with a concrete road and his super breath. The Super Friends find out that a group of Lava Men are the ones who are causing the trouble. Solderath, King of the Lava Men, wreaks havoc on the surface world because he feels the Lava Men have been living underground for too long while the humans occupy the surface. While the Wonder Woman fights the Lava Men, Superman stops a fire ball over the North Pole and Aquaman stops a giant whirlpool from draining the ocean. When the three Super Friends rejoin each other they defeat the Lava Men and return them back to the center of the Earth.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: Finally, Samurai and the Super Friends intervene when a 13th-century warlord escapes his own time to wreak havoc on present-day Japan in "The Warlord's Amulet."

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: First, the Super Friends fight "The Iron Cyclops" that threatens Metropolis.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: Wonder Woman and El Dorado respond to a series of art gallery robberies in Metropolis. They confront John Palette, a painter whose invention can turn paintings of his design into real life monsters that can steal for him.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: First, a space satellite returns to Earth with a deadly "Stowaway From Space."

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: In an arcade, The Wonder Twins and Gleek encounter a witch who shrinks them. As Zan and Jayna elude danger, they call Wonder Woman for help. Now Wonder Woman and the Wonder Twins must stop the witch before she shrinks all of the customers.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: Drawn into Mxyzptlk's dimension, Batman and Superman must find a way to escape in "Mxyzptlk's Revenge."

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.episodeName: Mxyzptlk's Revenge; Roller Coaster; Once Upon a Poltergeist
MissingItem.description: Drawn into Mxyzptlk's dimension, Batman and Superman must find a way to escape in "Mxyzptlk's Revenge." Next, the Wonder Twins and Atom rescue a teen gang from a deadly ride on a condemned "Rollercoaster." Finally, Apache Chief helps the spirit of an Indian find his final resting place in "Once Upon A Poltergeist."

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.episodeName: Warpland; Two Gleeks Are Deadlier Than One; Bulgor the Behemoth
MissingItem.description: Batman and Superman are accidentally trapped in a time warp and sent to the bizarre "Warpland." Next, the Super Friends discover that "Two Gleeks Are Deadlier Than One" when an android Gleek invades the Hall of Justice. Lastly, Apache Chief stops an author who transformed into the monster he's writing about, "Bulgor The Behemoth.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.episodeName: The Krypton Syndrome; Invasion of the Space Dolls; Terror on the Titanic
MissingItem.description: When Superman accidentally returns to Krypton's past, he wrestles with the idea of saving the doomed planet in "The Krypton Syndrome." Then, the Wonder Twins thwart the impending "Invasion of the Space Dolls." Lastly, "Terror on the Titanic" occurs when a huge slime monster raises the legendary ship from the bottom of the sea.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.episodeName: Revenge of Doom; A Pint of Life; Day of the Dinosaurs
MissingItem.description: The Legion of Doom reunites and capture Batman and Robin. After they restore the Hall of Doom, they then manage to immobilize Superman and Wonder Woman with Lex Luthor's crystalizing ray. The SuperFriends must free themselves and stop the Legion of Doom before they rob Fort Knox.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: Superman and Batman are pulled into a space warp where they come across a strange planet inhabited by aliens known as Zoons. The leader of the group, Super Frog, plans on keeping who he sees as invaders as prisoners. He then turns Superman into an eagle and Batman into a real bat. The aliens' headquarters is referred to as the Hall of Zoon. Fortunately Batman and Superman are able to warp into their own galaxy and the effects wear off...Batman remarks that Superman would have made a great eagle.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.episodeName: Return of the Phantoms; Bully for You; Superclones
MissingItem.description: "Return of the Phantoms": Three Phantom Zone villains travel back in time to destroy Superman as Superboy. "Bully for You": A young boy finds Batman's utility belt after he loses it and decides to use the belt to get even with a couple of bullies. Finally, "Superclones": Brainiac clones Aquaman and El Dorado creating two evil supervillains. The clones capture the real Aquaman and El Dorado and then commit crimes in an effort to ruin the good name of the Super Friends. The clones surrender to the authorities in order to be put on trial in efforts to get all the Super Friends out of the way. The real Aquaman and El Dorado must escape and reveal the truth of Brainiac's plan.

MissingItem.description: The Superfriends become "Prisoners Of Sleep" when Sleep, Demon of the Dream World, threatens to destroy them. Next, in "An Unexpected Treasure," two teenagers endanger their lives when they take an abandoned flying saucer for a ride. Later, "The Malusian Blob" threatens to destroy Gotham City.

MissingItem.episodeName: Attack of the Cats; One Small Step for Superman; Video Victims
MissingItem.description: When two scientists are accidentally transformed into cat people, Batman must thwart the "Attack of the Cats." Next, the Superfriends help a boy to walk again in "One Small Step for Superman." Finally, the Superfriends nearly become "Video Victims" when Bizarro traps them in a video game.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: Superman travels through a time warp and is taken back to the hours leading up to Krypton's explosion. He saves the planet by stopping the solar flares using the Super-Mobile core and then returns to the present to find Earth a very different place. Robin confronts him and has no idea who Superman is and then remarks that the Justice League was defeated by the Legion of Doom, he is the only one alive. He soon realizes that by saving Krypton that it erased his time on Earth and that nobody had ever heard of Superman before. He goes back into the time warp and makes sure Krypton explodes by removing the Super-Mobile Core because he figures that Earth would need a person like Superman to protect it.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.episodeName: Playground of Doom; Space Racers; The Recruiter
MissingItem.description: When three enormous alien children arrive on Earth, they begin to play with the world as if everything were merely their toys. Superman, Batman and Robin must find a way of stopping the children's rampant destruction.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: Batman and Robin foil some building constructors' plans to revive the Hall of Doom, which was destroyed in a previous encounter with the Super Friends, and turn it into a Museum. When Batman figures something is wrong, the building constructors reveal themselves to be Lex Luthor, Soloman Grundy, Sinestro and the rest of the Legion of Doom. The Legion of Doom proceed with their salvage operation, restoring the Hall of Doom to its initial deadly condition. When the Legion of Doom attacks Metropolis, Superman and Wonder Woman attempt to stop them only to get crystallized by Lex Luthor's Crystallization Ray. With the Super Friends defeated, the Legion of Doom take over the Hall of Justice to make their demands. Meanwhile Superman and Wonder Woman are able to move again thanks to Superman's X-Ray vision and are off to stop the Legion of Doom. Batman & Robin must find a way to reverse the polarity of Luthor's Crystallization Ray to transform Superman and Wonder Woman back to normal so the Legion of Doom's raid on Fort Knox can be put to an end.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: The three Phantom Zone villains are freed by an alien who doesn't realise they are criminals. In this episode they force the alien to travel back in time with them in an attempt to alter Superboy's life...hoping that he will never grow up to become Superman. Meanwhile, in the future, Superman and Green Lantern learn of the plot from the alien and travel back in time to save Superman's own past and capture the Phantom Zone villains.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: While investigating a strange electrified spiked metal pod, Superman and Batman unwittingly unleash the cloud-like prisinor inside, (named sleep) and are then trapped in a dream world. They have nightmares. Superman dreams that everything he touches turns to kryptonite. Wonder woman tries to save them by wrapping her golden lasso around her waist and entering the dream world. She instructs a minor to wake her in five minutes by tugging on the lasso. It works. Superman then breathes the creature into his lungs and blows him back into the pod.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: When two scientists are accidentally transformed into cat people, Batman must thwart the "Attack of the Cats."

MissingItem.title: Super Friends

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: Brainiac develops android duplicates of Superman and Wonder Woman in an attempt to seek revenge on the Superfriends. He enlists the reluctant help of Darkseid, who was tricked into following the android Wonder Woman right into Brainiac's star-ship. Darkseid and Brainiac hatch a plan to capture all the Superfriends... but, not long after their capture, it does not take long for the two egotistical villains to be at each other's throats. Darkseid and his gang whisk away with Wonder Woman through their stargate but it turns out to be the Wonder Woman android, and its Brainiac who indirectly has the last laugh on Darkseid.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends

MissingItem.description: The junior Super Friends find themselves under attack at the Hall of Justice by Lex Luthor and his shrink ray. A novice kid superhero proves a hindrance for the SuperFriends, but must take action when Lex Luthor steals his secrets.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends
MissingItem.description: Lex Luthor disrupts Darkseid's quiet time on Apokolips with a plan to destroy the Superfriends. One by one the Superfriends are lured into traps and zapped to Darkseid's palace. Luthor plans on stealing the powers from the Superfriends. In order to do this he needs the omega beams from Darkseid. Once Luthor has gained the powers of the Superfriends he quickly sets his sights on taking control of Darkseid's palace. The wily Darkseid, though, was prepared for a double-cross from Luthor. Suddenly, Luthor is powerless and the Superfriends are free... they regain their powers and they set out to stop Darkseid's latest plan. They thwart his plan but he escapes into his stargate. Afterward, Luthor is put in prison stripes.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends

The older members of the Justice League had earlier flown off to fight a mission in space... leaving behind the junior members like Robin, The Wonder Twins and Gleek, and Firestorm. Luthor succeeds in shrinking the Hall of Justice and it's up to the now miniature Superfriends to save the day before the senior members of the group return from space.

It's the only chunk of gold kryptonite, which can permanently strip away all of the powers that Superman enjoys on Earth. known to be in existence. Black Vulcan, Wonder Woman, and Firestorm infiltrate the auction under disguise as ice creatures. They plan on bidding high and taking the gold kryptonite before it can fall into enemy hands, but Darkseid soon realizes their plan.

A scientist named Dr. Dan Corwin had walked into what is referred to as a Geneto Beam and is turned into a Dinosoid, which means half-human/half-dinosaur. His partner flees and hides in the jungle... it's up to the estranged scientist, as well as Ronald, Robin, and Apache Chief to track down the evil scientist and transform everyone back to normal.

MissingItem.title: Super Friends

This succeeds but would later backfire when Apache Chief grows 50 feet tall and rattles the Starship, which causes the ice block (Zan) around Wonder Woman to break. Freed, Wonder Woman destroys Brainiac's mind control machine which returns the Wonder Twins back to normal. Later on Apache Chief, the Wonder Twins, and Wonder Woman are on hand to stop Brainiac and save the village.

MissingItem.description: This one-hour special takes a behind-the-scenes look at the past nine seasons of the hit drama about the thrilling and terrifying journey of the Winchester Brothers. Interviews include series stars Jared Padalecki, Jensen Ackles, Misha Collins and Mark Sheppard, along with series creator Eric Kripke and executive producers Robert Singer and Jeremy Carver. The stars and producers share stories and clips of their favorite memories, monsters, demons and angels from seasons one through nine and tease the upcoming action fans can expect in season ten.

MissingItem.title: Supernatural
MissingItem.description: Sam is about to graduate from college and has an interview set up to join one of the most prestigious law schools in the country. His brother Dean, whom he has not seen since he went to college, shows up in the middle of the night and tells him their father is missing while on a hunting trip. Leaving his girlfriend behind to find their dad, Sam joins Dean in an effort to find their father in a little town called Jericho, where unmarried men disappear without a trace.

MissingItem.title: Supernatural
MissingItem.description: Sam and Dean pose as Park Rangers to help a brother and sister search for their lost sibling, who the Winchester brothers believe may have been taken by a Wendigo.

MissingItem.title: Supernatural
MissingItem.description: While going through the newspaper, Dean comes across a mysterious drowning victim. Upon further research they soon discover more people who have drowned in the same lake, but their bodies were never found. When the boys show up in town they befriend a boy whose father has drowned. The brothers come to believe the lake is haunted by a spirit.

MissingItem.title: Supernatural
MissingItem.description: A friend of Dean's calls him up when a plane crashes under mysterious circumstances. Dean and Sam soon discover a flight attendant who was on the plane but they do not realize her full connection to the crash until they are on board another flight with her.

MissingItem.title: Supernatural
MissingItem.description: A man dies of a stroke in front of a mirror but Sam and Dean believe something, or someone else (Bloody Mary), may be behind his death. Dean tries to help Sam open up about his girlfriend's death, particularly after Sam lets it slip that there's some information that he hasn't told Dean.

MissingItem.title: Supernatural
MissingItem.description: Sam’s friend, Zach, is accused of murder. Sam offers to help out by checking up on his sister, Rebecca. Rebecca claims her brother could not have committed the murder because he was with her at the time of the murder. But all the physical evidence points to Zach being at the scene of the crime. Could Zach have been at two places at the same time?

MissingItem.title: Supernatural
MissingItem.description: Sam and Dean help a girl whose date became a victim of the "Hook Man," a famous urban legend that turns out to be real, in a small college town somewhere in Iowa. In order to save her and her father, the local minister, the brothers have to find the ghost's bones so they can destroy them. One tiny problem... they're in an unmarked grave.

MissingItem.title: Supernatural
MissingItem.description: Dean and Sam arrive in a town checking up a report of a mysterious death, and stop at a realtor's open house barbecue. Sam meets the realtor's son Matt, who is fascinated with bugs. Soon the town is invaded by swarms of deadly bugs, and there may be no way out.

MissingItem.title: Supernatural
MissingItem.description: Dean and Sam return to their home of Lawrence, Kansas, where a new family has moved into the Winchester's old home. The family begins seeing and hearing frightening things, and the brothers think it might be haunted by the thing that killed their mother.

MissingItem.title: Supernatural
MissingItem.description: If these walls could talk. The brothers investigate a long-shuttered mental asylum that has the power to drive intruders mad... and murderous.

MissingItem.title: Supernatural
MissingItem.description: Sam and Dean's father sends them to a small town where the citizens sacrifice couples to a pagan god which manifests through a scarecrow.

MissingItem.title: Supernatural
MissingItem.description: When Dean is accidentally electrocuted fighting a monster, he permanently damages his heart. When he's diagnosed as only having a month, at most, to live, Sam searches for a means to save him and finds Roy Le Grange, a faith healer who may actually be the real deal. After Le Grange heals Dean, the brothers discover that Le Grange is using black magic to bind a "Reaper" to do his bidding... and each healing comes with a terrible price.

MissingItem.title: Supernatural
MissingItem.description: Sam and Dean head to Missouri to investigate mysterious car accidents involving black men.

MissingItem.title: Supernatural
MissingItem.description: Sam's precognitive dream leads the brothers to investigate a mysterious death which seems connected to a boy with the power of telekinesis.

MissingItem.title: Supernatural
MissingItem.description: Dean searches for Sam when he is kidnapped by a backwoods family who likes to hunt humans and use their body parts as trophies.

MissingItem.title: Supernatural
MissingItem.description: Sam has a reunion with a girl he once met, Meg, but it turns out that she is using the brothers to lure their father John to his doom.

MissingItem.title: Supernatural
MissingItem.description: Sam and Dean investigate the case of a maniacal ghost inhabiting a long abandoned Texas farmhouse known as "Hell House." They believe the ghost is the spirit of a deceased Depression-era farmer who killed his family, but they soon realize it is something far more powerful.

MissingItem.title: Supernatural
MissingItem.description: Sam and Dean battle a Shtriga, a witch that sneaks into childrens' bedrooms and sucks the lives out of them. Dean must relive his childhood when he remembers that he encountered the Shtriga years ago.

MissingItem.title: Supernatural
MissingItem.description: The Winchesters must deal with a dangerous spirit bound to an old family portrait that brings misfortune and death to anyone who buys it.

MissingItem.title: Supernatural
MissingItem.description: To obtain a mystic gun capable of destroying the demon that killed their mother, Sam and Dean must team up with their father John and face off against vampires.

MissingItem.title: Supernatural
MissingItem.description: John has realized where the demon will strike next and the Winchesters head there to stop the next killing. But Meg begins killing John's friends and demands the Colt or she'll keep going until everyone John knows is dead.

MissingItem.title: Supernatural
MissingItem.description: When Meg boasts that John is her prisoner, the boys visit a friend of their father's to get information about demonic possessions and ways to trap a demon. It turns out Meg is not what she appears.

MissingItem.title: Supernatural
MissingItem.description: In the aftermath of the car crash, the surviving Winchesters go to the hospital, where one is stalked by a Reaper while another must consider sacrificing himself to save the others.

MissingItem.title: Supernatural
MissingItem.description: After the events at the hospital, the brothers have no idea where the demon that killed their mother is hiding. While biding their time trying to come up with an idea, they investigate murders committed by a killer clown.

MissingItem.title: Supernatural
MissingItem.description: Sam and Dean encounter a vampire hunter whose obsession may get them all killed.

MissingItem.title: Supernatural
MissingItem.episodeName: Children Shouldn't Play With Dead Things
MissingItem.description: Dean and Sam investigate the death of a young college student who died in a car accident, but whose grave is now surrounded by a circle of dead plants.

MissingItem.title: Supernatural
MissingItem.description: Sam and Dean meet Andy Gallagher, a slacker with psychic powers of persuasion. Once the brothers learn that Andy’s family was visited by the Demon, Sam wonders if he could be one of the special children.

MissingItem.title: Supernatural
